title: Deepgram Buys Daily, the Company Behind Pipecat Voice AI
dek: Pipecat stays open source, with a new open protocol for voice agents.

facts.label: Raised by Daily before the deal
Deepgram's Series C, making it a unicorn
New open protocol for voice agents

caption:
One of the most popular open-source voice AI toolkits just changed hands 🎙️

Deepgram is acquiring Daily, the company behind the Pipecat framework that links speech-to-text, LLMs and text-to-speech into low-latency voice agents. No price was shared, but both sides say Pipecat will stay open source and vendor-neutral, backed by an independent Pipecat Foundation.

Deepgram is also launching the Real-Time Context Standard (RCS), an open protocol built with the Pipecat team that lets voice agents use tone, volume and other audio cues to shape how they respond.

At AI Parabellum we see this as another sign the voice AI market is consolidating, alongside big raises at ElevenLabs, LiveKit and Vapi. If you build on Pipecat, watch how the foundation and roadmap evolve.
